summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The MarketDesk Focused U.S. Dividend ETF (FDIV) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in high dividend yield equity. The fund is actively managed, investing primarily in US companies that are forecasted to raise their dividends. The fund constructs its portfolio using a quantitative dividend screening methodology with the goal of generating above-average income FDIV was launched on Sep 19, 2023 and is issued by MarketDesk.

holdings.infoBox: FDIV is an equity ETF with a total of 63 individual holdings. The top holdings are HF Sinclair stock at 2.37%, Corebridge Financial at 2.26%, APA Corporation at 2.20%, Dollar General at 2.19%, and Citigroup at 2.16%.
